Class ended earlier by like 40 minutes, I guess I can go to you, especially after double gym. Parking was nice as there was a spot for me when I drove in, though going into the area is a different story (traffic light when). They took 20 minutes to serve, to my table somehow. Buzzer didn't buzz. - Hot chinese tea, then Hot Lemon tea. 1 cup each. - Sauce is saucing. - Bowl of soup. Tried to scoop the ones on top so it isn't that "dense". - Added noodles around 12 minutes in. - Left in around an hour. - Cleaned the plate.   • Chicken wing, masak merah

They changed layouts, and Uncle is no where to be seen.

Asked for sambal, nada. Asked for additional dhal & curry as I was about to finish, they filled it.

4.5? Went down to 4 as I only prepared 4. Asked the reason of why 4.5 despite the menu clearly being 1.5 + 2.5.

"Maybe there's planta in there?"..huh? Woman you make no sense, but if that's the case I'll order them separately.

No idea what to eat, time to try something new. Their QR is displayed as Mira Kitchen, not Amzira Shak Enterprise now (changed the previous 2 entries). - 3 chicken tenders, room temperature maybe - Rice isn't much. I can easily finish with 1.5 - 2 tenders, or 1 if I try hard enough. - Sauce is ok, but it's easily finished within 2 tenders. - 1 lettuce leaf, 2 slices of cucumbers - The drink is the usual Teh o Ais. Class -> Corpo Strat business that extended beyond 3pm (thanks Malaysian timing) -> An FYP meet that extended to 4pm (thankfully class online). Weather that edges when my class ends (its windy asf). Good. - 1 Egg Mayo: Lettuce, tomato, mashed egg, mayo. I prefer the top one. - 0 Tuna Spicy: didn't have any, as I'm not too big of a tuna fan to begin with (I think) - 1 Ribena & 1 chrysanthemum tea (drinho) consumed All in all, thankful I had my dinner prior. It exists in Cheras as one of my childhood (and current) foods, and it is ok from what I remember (most of the time). I decided to try the Cyberjaya branch which has been opened for... a year? Mixed Rice has koyogang as I see his car there, so it'd be best not to go there. It took around 10 minutes to serve, which is ok for a noodle dish. The place is quite empty as well (compared to Cheras), so I guess it's not that popular here? - Dry, Wanton Mee Thin (idk what is Thick), Add Noodles - Normal: 10.90 - Upsized: +2.00 - Smells like Cheras, tastes like Cheras. It gets a pass. Maybe it's because of the pricing, as what I remember is that the one in Cheras is around 10-11, but here is 12.90. Or maybe it's because of the location. But I'd say its best to eat something else for cheaper, unless one craves for the Cheras taste.
  • Dry, Wanton Mee Thin (idk what is Thick), Add Noodles
  • Normal: 10.90
  • Upsized: +2.00
  • Smells like Cheras, tastes like Cheras. It gets a pass.

I still finished the rice before chicken. - Vege 1 scoop: 2, anchovies, and another free root piece - Curry from curry chicken, taste is covered entirely by Masak Merah. Classic.
